mapper.select: SELECT c.id::text AS id, u.nickname AS author_name, t.target_type, t.target_key, COALESCE(p.title, t.target_key) AS title, CASE WHEN c.status = 'DELETED' THEN '' ELSE c.body END AS body, c.status, t.status AS thread_status, c.created_at FROM comments c JOIN users u ON u.id = c.author_id JOIN discussion_threads t ON t.id = c.thread_id LEFT JOIN publications p ON t.target_type = 'PUBLICATION' AND p.slug = t.target_key WHERE ORDER BY c.created_at DESC, c.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
